title: Castle Biosciences Approved for Dual Listing on Nasdaq Texas
summary: Castle Biosciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: CSTL), a company improving health through innovative tests that guide patient care, today announced that it has been approved to have its common stock dually listed on Nasdaq Texas, a new exchange headquartered in Dallas. Castle will maintain its primary listing on The Nasdaq Global Market, and its common stock is expected to begin listing on Nasdaq Texas today under its existing ticker symbol, "CSTL."
